name: Fated Love / Fated Death
source:
She is your Queen, your executioner, and your soulmate.

Have one final conversation with your enemy in this short interactive wlw visual novel.

[From [url=https://naoimh-murchan.itch.io/fated-love-fated-death]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
她是你的女王、你的刽子手、你的灵魂伴侣。

在这部简短的交互式wlw视觉小说中与你的敌人进行最后一次对话。

[来自[url=https://naoimh-murchan.itch.io/fated-love-fated-death]itch.io[/url]]
